title: From prediction error to sparse events: Biologically inspired signed-dyadic coding for Mandarin keyword spotting
abstract: arXiv:2610.41381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In continuous spiking keyword spotting, temporally correlated acoustic frames can repeatedly trigger memory access and neural computation at a dense input interface, even when hidden activity is sparse. Predictive processing and sensory adaptation suggest retaining predictable input locally and responding selectively to deviations. Inspired by this mechanism, we propose Predictive Signed-Dyadic Coding (PG). PG maintains a local prediction for each input channel and transmits an event only when the residual exceeds a learned threshold. Each event carries a sign and a finite power-of-two magnitude, and the receiver reconstructs it with fixed-point shifts and additions. In Mandarin keyword spotting, INPUT-PG reaches 90.00% accuracy while reducing mean SRAM reads by 33.87% and inference cycles by 32.77%. PG provides a hardware interface for research on low-power continuous speech processing and event-based sensory systems.

translated_title: 从预测误差到稀疏事件：面向中文关键词检测的生物启发带符号二进分数编码
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.41381v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在连续脉冲关键词检测中，时间上高度相关的声学帧即使在隐藏层活动稀疏的情况下，也可能在密集输入接口处反复触发内存访问和神经计算。预测处理与感觉适应机制表明，可以在本地保留可预测的输入，并选择性地对偏差做出响应。受这一机制启发，我们提出了预测性带符号二进分数编码（Predictive Signed-Dyadic Coding，PG）。PG为每个输入通道维护一个本地预测，只有当残差超过学习到的阈值时才传输事件。每个事件携带一个符号和一个有限的二的幂次幅度，接收端可通过定点移位和加法完成重构。在中文关键词检测任务中，INPUT-PG达到了90.00%的准确率，同时将平均SRAM读取次数减少了33.87%，推理周期减少了32.77%。PG为低功耗连续语音处理和基于事件的传感系统研究提供了一种硬件接口。
tldr: 提出一种生物启发的预测性带符号二进分数编码（PG），仅当输入残差超过学习到的阈值时才传输携带符号和二的幂次幅度的稀疏事件，在中文关键词检测中达到90.00%准确率的同时将SRAM读取减少33.87%、推理周期减少32.77%。
en_tdlr: A biologically inspired Predictive Signed-Dyadic Coding (PG) transmits sparse events, each carrying a sign and a power-of-two magnitude, only when the prediction residual exceeds a learned threshold, achieving 90.00% accuracy on Mandarin keyword spotting while reducing mean SRAM reads by 33.87% and inference cycles by 32.77%.
